system.description: You've learned to manipulate small objects without being spotted. Great for shoplifting. Make an INT-Opposed Skill Check. If someone's Perception is a higher Rank than your Sleight of Hand, you have Disadvantage. On Success, you maneuver the item without being noticed.

upgrades.description: You may attempt to pick the pockets of NPCs and Mobs.
You may attempt to plant items on someone with pockets or the equivalent.
You may manipulate items up to half your own size (rounded down).

system.limitations: Items you manipulate must be smaller than the size of your hand. You cannot access others' Inventories or Hotlists.
